new.title: PID entry is the public-to-case-data boundary
new.symptom: The primary public route stops at PID entry and cannot be walked past that point without personal or case data.
new.likelyCause: The next route stage requires a property identifier tied to a real assessment or property record.
new.recovery: No case data was entered for this research; use the published public route only and do not infer any post-PID screen or result.

corrections.reason: Protocol section 9 treats the public/case-data boundary as a route observation; the audited primary scenario is complete without entering a real PID.

support.auditNote: The integrated public workflow records PID and CAPTCHA inputs but no submission or case-data entry.
